note: Murray County (MN) publishes zoning only through its Beacon (Schneider Geospatial) viewer, which is behind a bot challenge and offers no public REST service or download, and as PDF maps (Official Zoning Map in the 2019 zoning ordinance; Slayton's Zoning_Map.pdf). ArcGIS searches for Murray County and Slayton zoning returned no district layer. The county GeoMoose viewer (geomoose.lyonco.org/MurrayMoose) was unreachable and the county maps page returned 403. No queryable zoning polygon service was found.
